notes.md: - **Earliest copper-plate grant (Andhra):** the **Patagandigudem** copper plates of Ikshvaku king **Ehuvala Chamtamula** (3rd c. CE) are the earliest known copper-plate land grant of south India; they record a grant to a **Buddhist monastery**.

- **Somadeva Suri** (Jain, 10th c.; not Somadeva of Kashmir): wrote the Sanskrit champu **Yashastilaka** (c. 959 CE) at **Gangadhara** in the **Vemulavada Chalukya** kingdom, and **Nitivakyamrita** on statecraft.
